  have h2 : b ∈ {3, 4} := by
    have h3 : b ≤ 12 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_left h with ⟨c, hc⟩ := by
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left (Nat.pos_of_gt hb)]
        exact Nat.le_mul_div_left b 12

      rwa [Nat.lt_def] at h4
    have h6 : b < 5 := by

    have h7 : b = 3 ∨ b = 4 := by

      · exact Or.inr h6
  exact h7
